title: Telco prediction MCP tool contracts
description: Input and output schemas for the three prediction tools exposed by the internal prediction-tools FastMCP service over streamable HTTP.

CustomerId.description: Stable customer_id from the normalized customer record.

TransactionId.description: Stable transaction_id assigned to one source RAFM row.

ModelVersion.description: Deployment artifact version recorded by prediction-tools; use the configured artifact digest or release identifier.

customer_ids.description: Customer IDs to score using the latest billing cycle per customer. Duplicate IDs are processed once, in first-occurrence order.

PredictChurnInput.description: Bounded request for churn classification. It has no database or run-persistence side effect.

class_id.description: Raw INT64 class returned by the LightGBM artifact. Semantic churn labels are not assigned until the artifact class metadata is verified.

PredictChurnResult.description: One class result for one customer; no probability is promised by the serving contract.

predictions.description: Unique customer results ordered by each ID's first position in the input.

transaction_ids.description: Transaction IDs to classify. Duplicate IDs are processed once, in first-occurrence order.

PredictFraudInput.description: Bounded request for RAFM transaction fraud classification.

class_id.description: ONNX class index; artifact class order is [False, True], so 0 is Non-Fraud and 1 is Fraud.

label.description: Human-readable label derived from the fixed ONNX class order.

is_fraud.description: True exactly when class_id is 1 and label is Fraud.

predictions.description: Unique transaction results ordered by each ID's first position in the input.

customer_ids.description: Customer IDs with an assigned QoE source sample/location. Duplicate IDs are processed once, in first-occurrence order.

PredictQoeInput.description: Bounded request for QoE scoring using the assigned Starlink source sample for each customer.

score.description: One QoE score on the trained model's 0–100 scale.

predictions.description: Unique customer results ordered by each ID's first position in the input.

code.description: Stable prediction MCP error code from contracts/errors.md.

message.description: Safe error message; raw SQL, endpoint details, and provider traces are excluded.
examples: The requested model is temporarily unavailable.

retryable.description: Whether the caller may retry under contracts/errors.md.

details.description: Safe error context; empty when there is no field-level detail.

x-tool-definitions.name: predict_churn
x-tool-definitions.description: Predict the raw churn class for the latest billing cycle of each customer.

x-tool-definitions.name: predict_fraud
x-tool-definitions.description: Classify each requested RAFM transaction as Non-Fraud or Fraud.

x-tool-definitions.name: predict_qoe
x-tool-definitions.description: Return the trained 0–100 QoE score for each customer's assigned location sample.

x-contract-guarantees.side_effects: Prediction calls do not persist application rows. A bounded disposable success cache may be updated; failures are not cached.
x-contract-guarantees.errors: Tool errors use McpError with INVALID_INPUT, SUBJECT_NOT_FOUND, MODEL_UNAVAILABLE, FEATURE_SCHEMA_MISMATCH, or UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT.
x-contract-guarantees.timeouts_retries: Maximum batch is 100 identifiers. Clients set a deadline and may retry only transient model unavailability or timeout once; never retry invalid input or feature mismatch.
x-contract-guarantees.ordering: Results include each subject ID and preserve first-occurrence input order. Duplicate IDs are deduplicated within a request.
x-contract-guarantees.versioning: Tool names and schemas are v1. Breaking changes require a new MCP schema version; additive output fields require consumer tolerance.

x-model-manifest-requirements.churn: The ordered semantic feature names and class interpretation are read from the deployed artifact manifest; the current design does not contain the exact feature list or class map.
x-model-manifest-requirements.fraud: Apply the training-time Plan_Type one-hot transform with drop_first semantics. The exact ordered feature names are read from the deployed artifact manifest. Class order is [False, True].
x-model-manifest-requirements.qoe: Preprocess latitude, longitude, elevation_m, visible_satellites, serving_satellites, signal_loss_db, season_encoded, weather_encoded in that order using the external scaler and label-encoder artifacts.
